recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Do not reintroduce notificationUrlLocation default text in core; future clarification should target Subscription.content and SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent.
issue_request: FHIR-30373 was a Published/Persuasive R5 FHIR-core Subscription clarification asking that Subscription.notificationUrlLocation document server behavior when unset, proposing empty notifications as none and other notifications as full-url.
initial_application: No source commit mentioning FHIR-30373 was found. Historical source before FHIR-36081 still had Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and subscription-url-location terminology, but the element definition only stated behavior if present and did not include the proposed default guidance.
additional_context: Subscription is an active current-build resource. Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-36081 removed Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and subscription-url-location terminology because SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent provides a fixed place for event resource references. Combined-branch audits already exist for FHIR-36081 and the related FHIR-30404 example request.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. Adding default guidance for Subscription.notificationUrlLocation would be incorrect in the current build because the element and value set were intentionally removed.

related_jiras.note: Removed Subscription.notificationUrlLocation and replaced URL placement negotiation with SubscriptionStatus.notificationEvent guidance.
Requested examples for notificationUrlLocation values and was already audited on the combined branch as obsolete after FHIR-36081.
External subscriptions backport twin of the default-guidance request, not a core source issue.
Later backport default-location question resolved no-change because notificationUrlLocation was removed from the backport IG.
